findings.description: Parity gate is vacuous if the engine flags are edited: dropping --strict-bytecode (K6) or the whole flags line (K7) passes, since outputs are identical and the sha check reads only the strict file.
findings.fix: Add a negative control to similar-test: assert the strict run fails or differs on a known VM-unsupported probe, or grep the recipe for --strict-bytecode, or reuse the existing strict harness conventions.

findings.description: similar-test is in test but not in ci-fast, though ci-fast carries strict/parity and the recipe costs ~30 s and needs no GPU or sky assets.
findings.fix: Add similar-test to ci-fast (the recipe uses zsh, as strict already does).

findings.description: Exported distances() is only tested on the valid corpus: its own guards (query validity, filter(valid, xs)) survive drills S23/S24 because rank() filters first. Raw radius and massUnit checks in normalize are likewise redundant with the post-normalisation valid(w) (S6, S8).
findings.fix: Add a direct distances(invalid, ws) and distances(q, ws ++ bad) assertion, or drop the redundant guards.

findings.description: The corpus-join test (finiteSystemOf at the TRAPPIST stop) takes 2m20s of the 2m47s file runtime on the loaded rig, slowing every package run and drills.
findings.fix: Accept for now; S0.2 may reuse a cheaper fixture.

findings.description: ailang#1914 handling is accurate: a named-test body containing :: fails to parse (reproduced, PAR_NO_PREFIX_PARSE), the same pattern in pure funcs works. Comments sit above five tests that were rewritten; the ties test and others are unannotated but use no ::.
findings.fix: None required; remove the comments when #1914 is fixed.

findings.description: Earth insolation is 1/1.00000018^2 (0.99999964), not exactly 1, because the cited Standish a is the Earth-Moon barycentre mean element. The tests pin this deliberately; it is a documented design choice.
